high_level_description: The image is a screenshot of an article from Computerworld, a publication by IDG. The content discusses a Swedish software-as-a-service (SaaS) startup named Funnel. The article highlights that Funnel specializes in combining and tidying marketing and advertising data for clients, regardless of where the data resides, to provide better insights into customers. Key points from the text include: The software is priced on a tiered basis depending on monthly ad spending, starting at $499 per month. Reference customers mentioned include Skyscanner, Samsung, and Ubisoft.
